name: utracer6
notes: Ronald Dekker's uTracer6 (1000 V / 1 A). FIRST DRAFT: several values are taken from uTmax 3.01, which was written without the hardware, and some sources disagree. Entries marked TO VERIFY must be checked against Dekker's uTracer6 schematic before the simulator can be used to judge uTmax's uTracer6 conversions.

hv_divider_top_ohm.source: uTmax 3.01 Update_adc_scales() uTracer6 branch and changelog 2.21k ('added 1meg resistor for ut6 voltage divider'). TO VERIFY

hv_divider_bottom_ohm.source: UNVERIFIED placeholder (gives about 1069 V full scale). In uTmax this is the RaVal calibration entry. TO VERIFY

anode_sense_ohm.source: uTracer6 notes (Dekker construction log): 4.7 ohm default sense resistors. TO VERIFY

supply_divider_top_ohm.source: uTmax 3.01 Update_adc_scales() uTracer6 branch; changelog 2.21k '10k/1k divider for positive supply'. TO VERIFY

neg_divider_top_ohm.source: uTmax 3.01 code uses (47+4.7)/4.7, but its changelog 2.21k says '200k/2k divider for negative rail'. CONFLICT, TO VERIFY

supply_volts.source: uTracer6 runs from a 19.5 V laptop supply (Dekker).

neg_rail_volts.source: uTmax 3.01 changelog 2.21m 'Changed Vneg to -15V for uTracer 6'. Our notes say the grid amplifier runs from a -85 V rail; which rail the ADC sees is TO VERIFY

grid_dac_bits.source: uTracer6 grid DAC is a DAC8562 (16-bit); uTmax 3.01 GetVg() uses a signed 16-bit word

grid_full_scale_volts.source: uTracer6 grid range 0 to -100 V (Dekker). uTmax's VgMax calibration entry must match. TO VERIFY

cathode_diode_drop_volts.source: uTmax adds a 0.5 V diode drop for the uTracer3; whether the uTracer6 has it is TO VERIFY

hv_switch_drop_volts.source: uTracer6 uses a MOSFET switch (FQD2N100), not the uTracer3's darlington. TO VERIFY
